## Details

<a id="update_boat"></a>
### [`update_boat`](../../../../src/enemy/boat.asm#L6) `$6A1F`

*routine*

Starts and moves the boat (sprite 1) on the river. A bomb burst or a bullet sinks it. Timer $4053 sets the next start.

- **Called from:** [`enemy_plane_update`](enemy_plane.md#enemy_plane_update)
- **Calls:** [`random_byte`](../game/random.md#random_byte), [`pick_special_target`](special_targets.md#pick_special_target), [`map_diagonal`](../plane/crash.md#map_diagonal), [`map_tile_at`](../ground/map_tile.md#map_tile_at), [`destroy_object`](../ground/ground_hits.md#destroy_object), [`add_score`](../game/score.md#add_score), [`count_target`](../game/score.md#count_target), [`remove_special_target`](special_targets.md#remove_special_target)
- **Reads:** [`boat_wait`](../data/variables.md#boat_wait), [`scroll_frames`](../data/variables.md#scroll_frames), [`quiet_timer`](../data/variables.md#quiet_timer), [`road_wait`](../data/variables.md#road_wait), [`airfield_countdown`](../data/variables.md#airfield_countdown), [`enemy_timer`](../data/variables.md#enemy_timer), [`vehicle_frame`](../data/variables.md#vehicle_frame), [`map_section`](../data/variables.md#map_section), [`river_column`](../data/variables.md#river_column), [`sprite_enable`](../data/variables.md#sprite_enable), [`sprite_mc_mask`](../data/variables.md#sprite_mc_mask), [`enemy_y`](../data/variables.md#enemy_y) and 9 more
